record.question: Who is the chairperson of 8th Pay Commission in India?
record.explanation: Answer A: Justice Ranjana Prakash Desai. The Union Government appointed Justice Ranjana Prakash Desai to chair the Eighth Central Pay Commission. Reference: https://pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=2094302. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: General Studies Paper-II, January 2026 examination; current affairs are interpreted as of the paper date.. Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
